name: The Experiments
description: Edison's lab, failures, and the method behind the genius.

cards.question: Edison famously said genius is 1% inspiration and 99% perspiration. Which best describes his lab method?

options.text: Careful theoretical planning before any experiments
Rapid, systematic trial-and-error with large teams

cards.question: How did Edison find the right filament for the light bulb?

items.text: Identified the need for a long-lasting, heat-resistant filament
Tested over 1,000 materials including metals and plant fibers
Discovered carbonized bamboo lasted over 1,200 hours
Filed the patent and demonstrated a practical light bulb

cards.question: Match each Edison lab to what it was known for.

pairs.right: First industrial research lab — light bulb, phonograph
Larger complex — motion pictures, improved phonograph
